rationale: I read the complete held EO 11841 original (40 FR 8933): its only operative act is to add a new section 306 (Development Coordination Committee) at the end of Part III of EO 10973, as amended. I read the held EO 12163 text (44 FR 56673): section 1-903(a)(1) revokes 'Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended', and section 1-506 re-establishes a Development Coordination Committee under section 640B of the Act with new membership. EO 11841 is not named in the revocation, but the order it amended is revoked in full 'as amended', so the added section 306 has nothing to operate on and is replaced by 1-506; EO 11841 contains no independent command. EO 12163 section 1-904 continues earlier actions and regulations only until amended or terminated; it is a savings clause for actions, not for the continued operation of section 306. EO 11959 and 12118 further amend EO 10973 and do not name EO 11841. The inference that revoking the parent as amended ends the amendment is mine and is the point the reviewer should test; the catalog note 'Revoked by: EO 12163, September 29, 1979' is a lead only. Provisional NO hypothesis; lifecycle chronology remains a gap.
